nameEn: Manufacture of knitted and crocheted apparel
description: This class includes the manufacture of knitted and crocheted wearing apparel.
includes: manufacture of knitted or crocheted pullovers, cardigans, waistcoats and similar articles
manufacture of knitted or crocheted stockings, socks and other hosiery
manufacture of knitted or crocheted tights and panty hose
manufacture of knitted or crocheted T-shirts and undervests
manufacture of knitted or crocheted swimwear and beachwear
manufacture of knitted or crocheted gloves
excludes: manufacture of knitted and crocheted fabrics, see 1391
manufacture of wearing apparel of woven fabrics, see 1410
